name: Spirit Fan

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

text:
This elegant black, gold-tipped +1 striking fighting fan is adorned with images of three golden leaves and a red rope tassel. If a creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points by a spirit fan, the golden leaves on the fan light up, providing illumination equal to that of a torch for 1 minute.

Effect: Spirit Fan

---
Activate—Release Life Energy 2 (concentrate, manipulate, vitality)

Requirements The spirit fan's leaves are illuminated

Frequency once per hour

Effect You sweep the spirit fan in the direction of a single target you can see within 30 feet, releasing the life energy in the form of a streak of golden light. The spirit fan goes dark. If the target is a living creature, the energy restores 3d8+8 healing,vitality Hit Points. If the target is undead, it takes 2d8+8 vitality damage (DC 23 basic Fortitude save save).
